prompt:
Create a new 16:9 storyboard keyframe for a music video. Image 1 is the style reference: match its 1990s hand-painted cel anime look, ink line quality, film grain and VHS softness exactly. Image 2 is FAST's model sheet: draw FAST exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Image 3 is SLOW's model sheet: draw SLOW exactly on-model (same face, hair, skin tone, glasses, outfit and props). Monochrome Japanese sumi-e ink wash rendering of the same cel anime style: black ink and grey washes on warm washi paper, brush texture, ink bleeds, no color at all, EXCEPT that FAST's windbreaker, if he appears, keeps a faint wash of its orange and teal (he is vivid in SLOW's memory).
Scene: Through the rain-streaked laundromat window: FAST zips past outside on his skateboard handing out free samples from a tray, a crowd chasing him, a 'FREE' sign; FAST's jacket is the only color in the ink-wash frame.
Camera: Over SLOW's shoulder, window as frame.
Characters: FAST and SLOW only, no one else unless the scene mentions extras. Their mouths are closed or relaxed (nobody is mid-word).
The only readable text in the image: 'FREE', spelled exactly and rendered as part of the scene on real objects. No other text, captions, subtitles or speech bubbles.
No borders, no panel frames, not a comic page.
